question: **Direction: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.**
solution:
The correct answer is **"Bouket"**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The incorrectly spelt word is **"Bouket."**
 
• The correct spelling is **"Bouquet"**.
 
• A **"bouquet"** is a collection of flowers that have been artistically arranged and tied together to be given as gifts or carried on **formal occasions**. (गुलदस्ता)
 
 
• ***Example:** I gave her a **bouquet__ **at her wedding.*
 
 
 
• So, the correct answer is **Option 3.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Rest three words are **grammatically correct**.
 
• Look at the meaning of the other words.
 
 
• **Barricade:** An obstacle or rampart built across a path or passage to impede the enemy's advance. (आड़; शत्रु की उन्नति को बाधित करने के लिए एक मार्ग या मार्ग में निर्मित एक बाधा या प्राचीर)
 
• **Prosperity:** the state of being prosperous or successful. (समृद्धि)
 
• **Dissatisfied: ** demonstrating or expressing dissatisfaction. (असंतुष्ट)
